versions.content: If CanIfPublicWakeupCheckValidSupport equals TRUE , CanIf enables the detection for CAN wake-up validation. Therefore, CanIf stores the event of the first valid call of CanIf_RxIndication() of a CAN Controller which has been set to CAN_CS_STARTED . The first call of CanIf_RxIndication() is valid: • only for received NM messages if CanIfPublicWakeupCheckValidByNM is TRUE • for all received messages corresponding to a configured Rx PDU if CanIfPub- licWakeupCheckValidByNM is FALSE .
